la: What does Kyle Daniel Gordon do?

He is an orchestrator, arranger and conductor in Los Angeles. He turns composers’ sketches and mockups into full orchestral scores, writes string and orchestral arrangements for artists, prepares scores and parts, and conducts recording sessions and concerts.

Credits include Rosalía’s LUX (supervising orchestrator, with the London Symphony Orchestra), Oppenheimer, Frozen II, Star Wars: The Last Jedi, Black Panther: Wakanda Forever, The Mandalorian, Haunted Mansion, Bridgerton and The Gilded Age, plus arrangements for the BBC Proms.
Yes. Scores and parts are delivered digitally, so he works with composers and artists anywhere. Recording sessions and concerts take place in Los Angeles, Nashville, London and elsewhere.
Can he write strings for a pop or alternative record?
Yes. Send a demo, stems or a rough mix and the size of ensemble you have in mind, from a string quartet to a full orchestra. See pop string arrangements.
Email kylegordonmusic@gmail.com with the project, the dates and what you need: orchestration, arrangement, score preparation or conducting.
contact: The project and your role, dates and deadlines, the music if you have it (mockups, demos, stems or a rough mix), the size of ensemble, and whether you need orchestration, an arrangement, score preparation or conducting.
Does Kyle work with independent artists?
Yes, as well as composers, labels, studios and orchestras. Many arrangements start from a simple demo.
Wherever the project needs: Los Angeles, Nashville, London (LUX was recorded at AIR Studios), or remotely with players you choose.
Biographies and photos are in the press kit. For anything else, email.
